WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.*, p.sku, p.subcategory AS sub_asof, cp.subcategory AS sub_current, p.category
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
 WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
   AND (p.subcategory='Interior Paint' OR cp.subcategory='Interior Paint')
)
SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d_rl, sum(quantity) qty, sum(CASE WHEN sub_current='Interior Paint' THEN quantity END) qty_cur, sum(CASE WHEN sub_asof='Interior Paint' THEN quantity END) qty_asof, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity END) staff_qty, min(quantity) minq, max(quantity) maxq, min(sale_date) mind, max(sale_date) maxd, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at) l1, max(etl_loaded_at) l2, sum(net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT sku) skus
FROM l

WITH f AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.quantity) qty, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) rc, count(*) lines
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT business_date, receipts, units_sold, net_sales_before_returns, returns_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=108 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02')
SELECT coalesce(f.sale_date, r.business_date) d, f.lines, f.rc, r.receipts, f.qty, r.units_sold, f.net, r.net_sales_before_returns, r.returns_net
FROM f FULL JOIN r ON r.business_date=f.sale_date ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'ret_in_period' k, sum(r.quantity_returned) v, count(*) n, NULL w FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
 WHERE s.store_id=108 AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ret_of_period_sales', sum(r.quantity_returned), count(*), NULL FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
 WHERE s.store_id=108 AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'subcat_variants', count(*), count(DISTINCT sku), subcategory||'|'||category FROM dim_product WHERE product_name ILIKE '%interior%' OR subcategory ILIKE '%interior%' GROUP BY subcategory, category
UNION ALL
SELECT 'skus_changing_subcat', count(*), NULL, NULL FROM (SELECT sku FROM dim_product GROUP BY sku HAVING count(DISTINCT subcategory)>1 AND bool_or(subcategory='Interior Paint'))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'test_sku_in_scope', count(*), sum(f.quantity), NULL FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.category='ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
GROUP BY 1, 2
